requirements.requirement: Vehicle Definition, variant/configuration, component Definition, owned Campaign Asset, deployment and live operational state remain distinguishable semantic layers.
Definition inspection, comparison or configuration selection never creates ownership, deployment or live runtime state and never rewrites reusable source facts.
Source-backed fact, source-unspecified, conflict, reference-only, governed inference, recommendation, Campaign state and runtime state remain distinguishable; unknown is not zero.
Ownership, custody, control, access, remote-operation grant, passenger status and station authority remain independent relations.
Vehicle ownership never silently grants pilot/driver/station authority and station assignment never transfers ownership.
Grant/revoke/transfer operations show explicit relation deltas, revalidate immediately before mutation and preserve ownership/control history.
Component parentage and compatibility require explicit governed evidence; name similarity and source-document grouping cannot create a parent or compatibility link.
Installation state, slot/hardpoint, readiness and configuration snapshot remain separate from reusable component Definition identity and component ownership.
Hidden installed systems are filtered before system counts, hardpoint summaries, readiness totals, capability tags, action menus, diagnostics, exports and AI context.
Crew/passenger/station assignment validates eligibility, current authority, declared command policy and expected version before commit.
Conflicting authorized crew commands resolve through declared command policy and authoritative version, never UI arrival order.
Revoking station/control authority immediately removes protected controls and invalidates protected cached route/system/Resource data.
Generic Asset containment/transfer/lineage follows PPIA-03 while vehicle hangar, attachment, carriage, deployment and launch semantics remain PPIA-04.
Carrier and carried craft retain separate Asset identities; load, attach, detach and launch mutate explicit relationships exactly once without cloning an Asset.

Hidden cargo, occupants, containers and carried craft are filtered before child counts, capacity summaries, weights/values, search facets, exports or AI context; unknown capacity is not zero or unlimited.
Scene deployment references the existing vehicle Asset and cannot create a duplicate vehicle identity.
Semantic zone/anchor, range, adjacency, facing, altitude/depth, velocity and environment state are authoritative where governed; canvas pixels and visual overlap are presentation unless rules-bound.
Accepted movement and governed Resource costs commit atomically under current station/control authority and expected-version checks.
Vehicle attack, scan, defense and other governed system operations use F007/F014 proposal/approval/result behavior and reauthorize actor/station/system/target before commit.
System outcome and governed ammunition/charge/power cost commit atomically; denied or failed-before-commit operations consume nothing.
Unauthorized action menus, failure text, readiness summaries and AI context cannot reveal hidden installed systems, targets or capabilities.
Current Resource values, known governed maxima and unknown/source-unspecified maxima are distinct; unknown is never coerced to zero, full, empty, unlimited or available.
Power/fuel/ammunition/heat/maintenance commands operate only on bounded governed models and never infer detailed circuit or power-grid topology from coarse data.
Resource spend, refill, reload, recharge and service operations use expected-version/idempotency protection and cannot double-apply after ambiguous network outcomes.
Hull/frame, motive, power, sensor, weapon/system, station and seal damage/failure are governed profile surfaces rather than one universal deletion rule.
Disabled, immobilized, adrift, destroyed, captured or salvaged state does not automatically erase vehicle Asset identity, Definition reference, ownership lineage or provenance.
Repair/service changes authorized instance/runtime state and appends history without rewriting source facts or duplicating Resource consumption/history on retry.
Docked, boarded, carried/attached, interior/exterior and launched are explicit semantic relations; visual overlap alone never commits docking or boarding.
Docking/boarding/launch revalidates Scene/vehicle/station authority and current relations/versions and commits related state atomically while preserving identities.
Capture/salvage separates custody/control changes from ownership lineage; authorized transfer preserves provenance and prior damage history.

Authorization and filtering precede vehicle existence, search, rosters, counts, totals, systems, capabilities, routes, Resources, history, provenance, exports, diagnostics, notifications and AI/service context.
GM authority remains Campaign-scoped, Assistant GM authority remains delegation-scoped, and Creator/Owner/Admin authoring authority does not silently become live Campaign mutation authority.
Service/AI actors receive only minimum authorized role-safe projections and cannot independently command, move, attack, route power, reveal, transfer or promote content.
Every authoritative vehicle mutation is expected-version checked and idempotent or governed by an equivalent concurrency contract.
Ambiguous network outcomes query operation status using the original operation ID before retry and reuse the same idempotency identity.

Reconnect reauthorizes current Campaign, role, grants, station authority, visible systems, Scene state and versions; cached revoked/hidden state cannot restore authority and no broad offline authoritative mutation is allowed.
Every core vehicle workflow has keyboard, touch and screen-reader-equivalent commands; drag, hover, color, animation, map memory or pointer precision is never the only path.
Movement/navigation/docking expose semantic list/table alternatives with origin, destination, relations, constraints, Resources and authoritative results.
Compact/mobile/high-zoom/reduced-motion layouts preserve vehicle identity, current station, operational state, alerts, validation and command completion without horizontal or motion dependency.
All 10 recovered R1 vehicle/system candidates remain source-review-only with zero automatic canonical Definition promotion, and the obsolete 487-object semantic database remains non-authoritative.
IA-D08-003 deferred simulation capabilities remain inactive and opaque/version-preservable rather than falsely operational.

Cross-domain handoffs preserve ownership of semantics: PPIA-03 generic Assets, F007 Actions, F013 positioning, F014 vehicle operations, F020 privacy and F021 recovery are inherited without inventing new domain rules or activating STAGE-A-A2.
